title: feat(nm2simx): simultaneous M and O at t+1 on two-axis opposite x-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Two-axis opposite seed, x-probes, simultaneous: hold/hold on the cell where axis-cover gives fail/fail (#7307). Together with #7378 and #7381 it shows sim is insensitive to the probe direction that cover resolves.
